serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: It’s here.
Shanice: I was hoping for some secret lab, but it’s just a destroyed flat. What a bummer…
Bot: Not necessarily. There was a fire here. Multiple points of origin. That would suggest that someone did it on purpose.
Shanice: How did you notice this?
Bot: I watched all seasons of Law & Order.
Shanice: There are like fifty of them. Impressive.
You: That’s the impressive part for you? 
Bot: There’s more. See the lighter spots on the ground? Something was taken from here. Outlets on the wall would imply electrical devices. Many of them.
Shanice: Server racks?
Bot: Possibly. 
Shanice: Even if this is the place where you were made, we still don’t know how you ended up in a ditch near Anon’s apartment.
You: Actually, I saw a military truck. She fell off from the cargo compartment.
Shanice: Did you see the plate number?
You: Sorry, it was dark and I wasn’t paying attention.
Shanice: Did it actually have our military’s markings?
You: I don’t know that either…
Shanice: It’s ok. Don’t worry about it.
Shanice: So what do we know so far? 
Bot: This place was used as some sort of hidden lab, someone set it on fire and then everything was retrieved and packed in a military-like truck from which I fell off and ended up in a ditch.
Shanice: I wouldn’t call it a breakthrough, but we learned something.
Shanice: Let’s look around a little, maybe we will find something.
You: In these ruins? There is only rubble and ash…
Shanice: It’s worth a shot. We can look around if we are already here.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Don’t tell me- Are you scared?
You: No I’m not!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: So give us a second. We will be done soon enough.
